headline: Revenue and margins climb sharply as guidance moves higher
summary_short: Autodesk's fiscal Q1 2027 revenue rose to $1,934M (the release states +18% y/y) as GAAP operating margin expanded 14 points to 28% and GAAP diluted EPS reached $2.32, prompting management to raise full-year FY2027 guidance.
summary_long: Revenue grew across every segment and region: Design +18%, Make +25%; by product family AECO +20%, Manufacturing +19%, AutoCAD/AutoCAD LT +15%; EMEA led geographies at +21%. GAAP operating margin expanded 14 points to 28% and non-GAAP margin rose 2 points to 39%, lifting GAAP EPS to $2.32 (from $1.62) and non-GAAP EPS to $2.99 (from $0.70). Free cash flow rose 58% to $876M; Autodesk repurchased $448M of stock and held $2,671M cash. Current RPO grew 18% y/y to $5,383M. Management raised FY2027 guidance to $8,155-8,215M revenue and $12.40-12.65 non-GAAP EPS (excluding the newly announced MaintainX acquisition), citing first-quarter strength and continued sales-reorganization progress.

drivers.explanation: Growth was broad-based: Design revenue rose 18% and Make rose 25% y/y; by product family AECO grew 20%, Manufacturing 19%, and AutoCAD/AutoCAD LT 15%; EMEA led regions at +21%.
Not explained in the release beyond general references to solid execution and the ongoing sales-force reorganization; no specific cost or leverage driver was quantified for the margin move.

EPS growth follows arithmetically from the revenue and margin gains above, aided by $448M of share repurchases in the quarter reducing diluted share count; the release cites no separate EPS-specific driver.
